qa.name: answer_relevance
qa.description: The degree to which the response directly addresses the question and remains focused on the requested topic.

qa.name: faithfulness
qa.description: The extent to which the response is supported by the provided evidence and avoids unsupported claims.

qa.name: factual_accuracy
qa.description: The correctness and reliability of the factual information contained in the response.

qa.name: logical_coherence
qa.description: The consistency, clarity, and soundness of the reasoning presented in the response.

qa.name: completeness
qa.description: The extent to which the response covers all important information required to fully answer the question.
